title: Aged Care Amendment (Independent Complaints Arrangements) Bill 2015
short_title: Aged Care Amendment (Independent Complaints Arrangements) Bill 2015

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would transfer responsibility for handling aged care complaints from the Department of Social Services Secretary to the existing commissioner, separating complaints handling from departmental regulation.

The commissioner would manage and resolve complaints instead of reviewing departmental decisions, supported by authorised complaints officers with specified investigation and information gathering powers.
The changes would begin on a proclaimed date or after six months if no proclamation is made, with transition rules available for complaints already underway.
changes: The office would be renamed Aged Care Complaints Commissioner.
Approved providers would have to cooperate with people exercising the new complaints powers.
Authorised officers could enter premises with occupier consent, which could be withdrawn at any time.
The commissioner could disclose protected information in specified circumstances, including to prevent serious risks to a care recipient’s safety or health.
summary.affected: Aged care recipients, complainants, approved providers, departmental staff and the Aged Care Complaints Commissioner would be affected.

speeches.speaker: Bob Baldwin
speeches.brief: The member for Paterson supported the Aged Care Amendment (Independent Complaints Arrangements) Bill 2015, noting that Paterson has the fourth-highest number of residents over 70 in Australia, with 18,642 people aged over 70 making up 15.6 per cent of the electorate's population.

speeches.speaker: Kelly O'Dwyer
speeches.brief: The Aged Care Amendment (Independent Complaints Arrangements) Bill 2015 transfers aged-care complaints handling from the Department of Social Services to the Aged Care Complaints Commissioner from 1 January 2016, implementing recommendations from the 2009 Walton review and the Productivity Commission's 2011 report.

acts.title: Aged Care Amendment (Independent Complaints Arrangements) Act 2015
